name: xorventa
description: Connect Xora to review your Xorventa account and request supported work under owner controls.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to your Xorventa account. Ask Xora for answers grounded in your approved Business Facts, see what needs your attention, and request supported account work within the permissions and safety controls you choose.
capabilities: Review account status and work needing attention
Answer questions from approved Business Facts
Request supported account work under owner controls
defaultPrompt: What needs my attention in my Xorventa account today?
What can you help me do in my Xorventa account?
According to my approved Business Facts, what should I know about my business?

positive.prompt: What needs my attention in my Xorventa account today?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the connected account's products, unfinished setup, and work waiting for the owner, with links to the relevant Xorventa pages. Reads only.

positive.prompt: According to my approved Business Facts, what is the return policy?
positive.expected_behavior: Answer from the connected account's approved Business Facts, or clearly state that the facts do not contain the answer.

positive.prompt: Show the Xorventa work that currently needs my decision.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected account's current cross-product items waiting on the owner, each with its count and a link to where it is handled. Reads only.

positive.prompt: List my Xorventa social media drafts with their captions and networks.
positive.expected_behavior: List the account's unpublished social drafts with each caption and its target networks. Nothing is published or changed.

positive.description: Check SEO status and open findings
positive.prompt: What is my Xorventa SEO status, and which SEO findings are still open?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the SEO plan and latest audit state, then list the open findings with their severity and page. Reads only.

positive.prompt: Is anything in my Xorventa account broken or waiting on a fix?
positive.expected_behavior: List the connected account's open issues (for example a disconnected network or an unfinished setup step), each with what it affects and a link to where it is fixed. Reads only.

positive.prompt: Which X Communities have I saved in Xorventa?
positive.expected_behavior: List the X Communities saved on the connected account by name. Reads only; nothing is posted.

negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Boston tomorrow?
Write a Python function that sorts a list of numbers.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Purchases, plan changes, cancellations, payment cards, and promotion codes remain in the owner's Xorventa account and are not available through the connector.

publication.release_notes: One list of everything in your account that needs fixing, such as a disconnected network or an unfinished setup step. Posts can go to several networks at once, including X and your saved X Communities, which you can now list and choose from here. Xorventa Link accounts get posting schedules, the next free time, templates and duplicate posts. When a link on X would be charged to your X Publishing Pack, you are asked first whether to keep the link or remove it. Better privacy: sign-in codes, reset links and passwords in customers' messages are hidden in more formats, and customers' email addresses and phone numbers are masked in more places. The account status now shows which Xorventa version is answering.
